e.title: AXA XL AI 人才发展
e.summary: AXA XL：AI 重塑人才发展（保险公司人才 AI 化案例）
e.body:
「AI reshapes talent development at AXA XL」（insurancebusinessmag）：AXA XL（大型再保/商险公司）用 AI 重塑人才发展——保险公司的人才 AI 化案例。对 RIAA：保险公司人才 AI 化的实例——与 [[aia-ai-coworker]]（AIA AI 同事）、[[ai-rewriting-insurance-skills]]（技能改写）配套：港险 + 国际险企的人才 AI 化案例；理解企业如何用 AI 做人才发展（培训/技能/招聘）；求职者对「企业 AI 人才战略」的认知。

e.body_en:
'AI reshapes talent development at AXA XL' (insurancebusinessmag): AXA XL (a major reinsurance/commercial insurer) uses AI to reshape talent development — an insurer's talent-AI-ification case. For RIAA: an instance of insurers' talent-AI-ification — with [[aia-ai-coworker]] (AIA AI co-worker) and [[ai-rewriting-insurance-skills]] (skill rewriting) it frames HK + international insurer talent-AI cases; understand how enterprises use AI for talent development (training/skills/recruiting); job seekers' awareness of 'enterprise AI talent strategies'.
